shape: コ (sideways C, narrow corridor wrapping a void)
description: Sideways C / コ shape: a narrow L-shaped corridor wrapping around a large central void. The autopilot MUST stay strictly on the authored backbone — most of the room's apparent floor is void or visual-mesh-only, and an off-script step in the wrong direction will drop the player. The north gate is at the WEST end of the south arm; the south gate is at the EAST end of the north arm. Reaching one from the other requires walking the full L (north arm east → corner → south arm west).

portals.north: spawn_north at (-16.34, -23.60) — west end of the south arm of the コ
portals.south: spawn_south at (9.55, 22.90) — east end of the north arm of the コ

anchors.description: north arm, east end — joins south_gate (matches 9zhk)
east-side corridor, north of the south-arm bend (matches qhl8)
south arm, east end (matches mm43) — a side-branch helper for objectives
south arm, west end — joins north_gate (matches rabl)
north arm, west end — corner detour, often holds a switch (matches etp1)

traversalNotes: STRICT-BACKBONE RULE: most of the room around the コ corridor is void or sloped wall — the solver MUST NOT emit any edge that isn't in anchorEdges, even if the navgrid + floor-coverage check pass. This stage's corridor width is narrow; off-script diagonals will drop the player or wedge the capsule.
Direct route (south → north): spawn_south → north_arm_east (9zhk) → east_bend_north (qhl8) → east_bend_south (hsna) → south_arm_west (rabl) → spawn_north. Six hops along the L.
Reverse (north → south): mirror of the above.

Switch placement: in-cell switches typically live at the corner detours — most often near north_arm_west (etp1) or north_arm_east (9zhk). When a switch is present, route current_gate → backbone → corner_detour → switch_press → corner_detour → backbone → next_gate. The corner_detour anchor stays a child of the backbone anchor it branches from.

Do NOT use east_bend_south → south_arm_west as a shortcut that skips south_arm_east when an objective is at south_arm_east — keep the dispatch rule strict (backbone → branch → objective → branch → backbone).
Stages are never physically rotated — all positions here are stage-local mesh-space XZ; cell.rotation in the quest plan is a gate-label swap only.
